Title: TC-01 Login with valid demo account
Description: Verify a registered user can log in and reach Home
Steps:
1. Launch FreshCart
2. Enter email demo@freshcart.app
3. Enter password Demo@123
4. Tap Log in
Expected Result: Home screen opens showing 'Hi, Demo User!', the search box and the product list, all fully visible

Title: TC-02 Login with wrong password
Description: Verify an invalid login is rejected with a clear message
Steps:
1. Launch FreshCart
2. Enter email demo@freshcart.app
3. Enter password Wrong@123
4. Tap Log in
Expected Result: Error 'Incorrect password' is shown and the user stays on the Login screen

Title: TC-03 Search for a product
Description: Verify the search box filters the product list
Preconditions: Logged in as the demo user
Steps:
1. On Home, tap the 'Search products' box
2. Type mango
Expected Result: The search box is fully visible and can be tapped; the list shows only 'Alphonso Mango'

Title: TC-04 Filter products by category
Description: Verify the category chips filter the list
Preconditions: Logged in as the demo user
Expected Result: Only Milk Toned, Paneer, Curd and Butter are listed; Butter's ADD button is disabled (out of stock)

Title: TC-05 Add products to cart
Description: Verify adding items updates the cart count and subtotal
Steps:
1. On Home, tap ADD next to Alphonso Mango
2. Tap ADD next to Apple Shimla
3. Check the bottom button
Expected Result: Toasts confirm both items; the button reads 'View cart (2) · ₹630'

Title: TC-06 Change quantity and remove item in cart
Description: Verify cart items can be updated and removed
Preconditions: Cart contains Alphonso Mango and Apple Shimla
Steps:
1. Tap View cart
2. Tap + on the FIRST item (Alphonso Mango)
3. Tap Remove on the FIRST item
Expected Result: Step 2: Mango quantity becomes 2 and the subtotal updates. Step 3: Mango is removed and the user stays on the Cart screen

Title: TC-07 Apply SAVE50 coupon
Description: Verify coupon discount and minimum order rule
Steps:
1. In Cart, enter SAVE50 in Coupon code
2. Tap Apply
3. Reduce the cart so the subtotal is below ₹300
Expected Result: Step 2: 'SAVE50 applied' and Discount -₹50 shown. Step 3: the coupon is removed or flagged as not applicable, and the total is correct

Title: TC-08 Place order with Cash on delivery
Description: Verify the end-to-end checkout creates exactly one correct order
Preconditions: Cart contains Alphonso Mango and Apple Shimla (subtotal ₹630)
Steps:
1. In Cart, tap Proceed to checkout
2. Enter mobile 9876543210
3. Enter address 12 MG Road Bandra West
4. Enter pincode 400050
5. Select 'Today 6 PM - 8 PM'
6. Tap Place order
7. On the success screen, tap View my orders
Expected Result: Success screen shows an Order ID and the correct total. My Orders shows exactly ONE new order with that total

Title: TC-09 Place order button tapped twice
Description: Verify a double tap does not create duplicate orders
Steps:
1. Complete steps 1-5 of TC-08
2. Double-tap Place order quickly
3. Open My Orders
Expected Result: Only ONE order is created; the Place order button is disabled while the order is being placed; no ₹0 order appears

Title: TC-10 Checkout validation
Description: Verify invalid delivery details are blocked
Steps:
1. Go to Checkout
2. Enter mobile 12345
3. Tap Place order
Expected Result: Error 'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number' is shown and no order is placed

Title: TC-11 Rotate during checkout
Description: Verify entered details survive a screen rotation
Steps:
1. Go to Checkout
2. Fill all fields and choose a slot
3. Rotate the device to landscape and back
Expected Result: All entered details and the selected slot are kept

Title: TC-12 Logout
Description: Verify logout clears the session and the cart
Steps:
1. Tap the ⋮ menu → Profile
2. Tap Log out
3. Relaunch the app
Expected Result: The Login screen is shown; after logging in again the cart is empty
